I couldn't verify this against the literature, so this is a best guess rather than a derived result. My tentative answer is $w_{\max} = q$. The natural candidate is the weight $q$ threshold, where Thakur's known depth-two relation $\zeta(1,q-1)=\zeta(q)/(T-T^q)$ first appears. That relation has coefficients in $K=\mathbb{F}_q(T)$ rather than $\mathbb{F}_q$, so it does not directly give the $\mathbb{F}_q$-linear relation the question asks about.

ANSWER: $q$
